textRuns.value: Model: 70% training / 30% stratified test split, random seed 42. Risk scores exist only for 20,997 test patients. The model-performance page shows fixed full-test metrics and training odds ratios. Capacity and subgroup pages apply one common score threshold set on all test patients, so slicers do not move it; original risk deciles remain fixed. Score ties may flag slightly more than requested capacity.
